pack_variants.label: Google Cloud / Workspace audit JSON relay
pack_variants.description: One-line JSON records preserving Google Cloud LogEntry/AuditLog or Workspace Reports Activity structures.
known_limitations: No live Google relay replay/read-back captured.

Selected GCP audit log and Workspace Activity families are fixture-backed; GCP authorizationInfo allow/deny coverage is narrow; Workspace Calendar coverage is limited to ACL activity; Workspace SAML coverage is limited to login success/failure activity with narrow failed-login context; service-specific payload extensions remain partial.
Pub/Sub/API/collector envelope metadata and service-specific payload extensions need local capture before SecHub can state broader coverage safely.

cribl.notes: Use only after sampling local Google exports. Do not drop authentication, caller IP, resource, service/method/action, Workspace events parameters, timestamps, or raw JSON by default.

vector.notes: Vector support is recorded as a conservative sources/transforms/sinks mapping only: collector/API relay path; keep credential custody and checkpoints outside this pack and preserve source timestamps and raw payloads. No Vector config artifact is generated by this pack yet.

fluent_bit.notes: Fluent Bit support is recorded as a conservative collector/pipeline mapping only: collector/API relay path; keep credential custody and checkpoints outside this pack and preserve source timestamps and raw payloads. No Fluent Bit config artifact is generated by this pack yet.

known_limitations: No live Google Cloud/Workspace relay replay/read-back captured.
This pack does not implement API polling, Pub/Sub subscription, Storage export reading, or credential custody.

Selected GCP audit categories (Admin Activity, Data Access with narrow authorizationInfo allow/deny examples, System Event, Policy Denied) and Workspace login/admin/Drive/token/Groups/Calendar ACL/SAML login families are synthetic-fixture-backed; service-specific extensions remain partial.
Service-specific protoPayload extensions and Workspace application parameters vary and are not exhaustively normalized.
Data Access and Drive activity logs can be high-volume and sensitive; no reduction is enabled by default.
